title: Theo and the Signal
author: Marguerite Quintana
blurb: Orsen Pemberton, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
